steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Heave—ho—

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Heave—ho—

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Helen?!

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: I thought you said you might be leaving. Did you come to pack your stuff?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Yeah, uh, I mean, no. Miss Jara gave me a month of PTO. I thought that was her way of telling me to resign.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Turns out she was retiring.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: She took me out for dinner before she left and said she hoped I would continue to work for Rhine.

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: That's great to hear! So the Pantry Alliance lives?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: You know, I kind of wish they’d just fire me.

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: ...Wait, today's Saria's first day in her new position, right? Are you still the Control's secretary?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Yeah. I get back to work after lunch break.

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Haha, I see.

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: I guess Miss Jara really trusted you, didn't she?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: No idea.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: All I know is that I could count the total number of times I saw Kristen in the office all these years with my two hands.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: I end up hearing about most things on the news first. The same goes for this changing of the guard. I don't even know what happened...

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Sometimes I can't help but think, am I actually working for Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Of course you are! You know how many trees there are in the lobby, how many lights there are on the ceiling, how many desks there are on each floor... that's exclusive, insider info!

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Look, I'm being serious.

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Sorry, just a little joke. Anyway, weren't you complaining that you had nothing to do when you were Kristen's secretary?

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: You know Saria's reputation as a thing-doer. You won't be bored when you're around her.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: I also know her reputation for being difficult. Why do you think I'm standing here?

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Huh? Oh yeah, this way leads to the Defense Section, doesn't it?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Saria wants to use the office of the Defense Section Director as the new Control's office.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Apparently, my first job is to convince the new Control to move her office.

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Well, I'll wait for the good news.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: You're just waiting to laugh at me, aren't you?

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Hey, no one's ever won a battle against Saria in the history of Rhine Lab. You'll be famous if you're the first one.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Oh, screw you. Guess I'll go now to meet my fate.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Good afternoon, Control. My name is Helen—

steps.name: Policy Specialist
steps.text: Maylander requests permission to intervene in the investigation on the Hall of Stasis.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Have we completed our investigation and recovery efforts?

steps.name: Policy Specialist
steps.text: Yes. All relevant assets have been entered into the database.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Then give Maylander the necessary permissions.

steps.name: Policy Specialist
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Components Control Section Staff
steps.text: Did you need something, Control?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've reviewed the ongoing and pending projects in each section. Bring me a detailed report on the marked items, including staffing, revenue, and expenditure.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've sent you the link.

steps.name: Components Control Section Staff
steps.text: All projects associated with Trimounts... I see. I'm on it.

steps.name: Acting Structural Section Director
steps.text: The quarterly report of the Structural Section is ready, ma'am. We would like to request early approval for additional budgeting of Project Three for the current quarter.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've looked at the request. Looks fine overall. Approved.

steps.name: Structural Section Financial Officer
steps.text: Things are quite chaotic following the loss of Director Parvis. We are unable to come up with the funds immediately.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Freeze the assets of Project Two and use it for Project Three.

steps.name: Structural Section Financial Officer
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've reviewed the progress reports and data on Project Two. They are unsatisfactory. Inform the director of Project Two that I will be auditing it personally.

steps.name: Structural Section Financial Officer
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Policy Specialist
steps.text: District officials would like to discuss our pilot qualifications and ongoing experiments in certain fields.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Make an appointment for tomorrow. I'll oversee the discussion. Make sure the relevant directors are present, and inform the officials of the time.

steps.name: Policy Specialist
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (She's dealing with all these requests simultaneously... efficiently, effectively...)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (She doesn't even notice me...)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Oh dear, Helen, what should you do?)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (An appointment request from Mr. Justin Jr.?)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Remarks... 'a young man with potential'?)

steps.name: Excited Young Man
steps.text: G-Good afternoon, Control. My name is...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Justin Jr. mentioned it. Sky Jagger, 'a future star'.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Eh, hehe, he's exaggerating...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Of course. Justin Jr. sees more future stars than there are stars in the night sky over Trimounts.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I understand. I'm not arrogant enough to think I'm more special than anyone else.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: But I promise that I—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Did Justin Jr. tell you about my rules?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: At least he knows the meaning of confidentiality.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Put on your protective gear and gloves.
Saria points towards the boxing ring in a corner of the office.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You want Rhine Lab to invest in your passion project? Last three minutes in the ring.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: If this is your way of interviewing people, I've got no reason to decline. If you're just being an a-hole, then all the more reason for me to make you realize that you're messing with the wrong guy.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (God, this guy is completely clueless!)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Saria's toughness is the stuff of legend... why would she...?)

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Frankly, this is easier.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: For a long time, I eavesdropped on TIT classes by day, and fought hoodlums in the slums by night.
Saria and Sky put on gloves and enter the ring. A fiery bout ensues.
Helen watches on blankly.
A violent clash beyond her comprehension is unfolding in the old office of Rhine Lab's new Control. Is that how she intends to decide the fate of a young man?
Once again, Helen is sure that she never knew Rhine, even after all these years.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (...Fifty-seven seconds.)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (...One minute, thirty-two seconds.)

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Stop.
The boxing stops. Sky is on the floor on one knee, the entire side of his face swollen.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Argh—my face, my shoulder...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: You were holding back, weren't you? You hardly broke a sweat.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You lost.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Rhine Lab will not invest in your project.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: ...Because of my educational background?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Your file shows that you completed all coursework for a degree in engineering science, despite never being officially enrolled in the Trimounts Institute of Technology. Not the most scrupulous of methods, but your grades were strong.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We're fellow alumni, in a sense.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Rhine Lab welcomes everyone who respects science.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Then why?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I read your proposal on the development of impact-resistant aviation materials last night.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's an area with great potential. You're sharp, but you lack an adequate grasp of the project's foundation, and many of your ideas are impractical.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Then why not just reject me?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You've got a strong constitution and a chip on your shoulder. You have everything a scientist needs outside of professional skills. What you need now is experience with real research projects and learn how they are built, brick by brick.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Are you interested in joining the Rhine Lab Engineering Section, Sky Jagger?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Lemme guess... Energy?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Engineering.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Nasti won't like him. Or should I say, they won't like each other.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Nasti might be able to teach him some things.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Satisfied?

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: With what, Control?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: He's underqualified and you know it. I take it you recommended him as a reminder to me.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Hehe. What I didn't tell you is that Sky is a superfan of Kristen's.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: He decided to commit himself to science and join Rhine Lab because he saw the sky that night...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Then I'm glad he didn't try to earn sympathy points by telling the story.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: That wasn't what caught my attention. Don't you think he's exactly what Rhine needs in this new era?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Rhine has gone through dramatic changes, and it will continue to face new challenges. We do need talent.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: But I must remind you of one thing.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: There is no new era.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: There are people with knowledge but no formal education in every era. They're the kind of people that science needs.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: But it's only now that they'll get their chance.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: If you don't mind me asking, how do you plan on dealing with Ferdinand?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I don't have any plans. He doesn't need me to worry about him.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: If he gets himself out and wants to come back to Rhine, tell him that he needs to get in my ring before he can get back to his desk.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'll let him wear his power armor, of course.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Heh. I'll tell him.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (What's she doing...?)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (A shower? Now?)
For some reason, Helen feels like a great weight has been lifted off her shoulders the moment Saria walks into the shower room.
She slumps on the sofa.
Helen had worked under Jara for years before joining Rhine Lab. She quickly took to the energy and vitality of Rhine Lab after joining it at Jara's invitation.
She was a hard worker, a workaholic even. She even earned a degree in energy science so that she could work more effectively at Rhine Lab.
Her efforts earned her a promotion to the post of the Control's secretary.
Little did she know that this would be the beginning of a nightmare.
Helen had little opportunity to do actual work under the elusive Kristen. Not only that, from the perspective of someone who at least tried to participate, Helen knows full well—
Kristen was a genius. She fully understood everything that was going on at Rhine Lab; she just didn't care about most of it.
The thought tormented Helen. She found it hard to accept that the leader of the company that she loved so much did not love what she had created.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Anyone else would have perceived Saria's attitude as being the polar opposite of Kristen's.)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Somehow, I have a feeling that they're very alike in a way...)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Wait, Saria just turned down all upcoming appointment requests on her terminal and pushed back all meeting requests and document reviews by one hour?)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Is she taking a break?)
She sees Saria walk to the other side of the ring, where there is a window and a table, with a shelf next to them that has various potted plants lying on it.
Saria takes out an empty pot from the shelf and lays it on the table.
Helen is surprised to see something 'grow' beneath Saria's palm from the black gravel.
A 'shoot', so delicate it seems to be crafted from jade, rises from the dirt, followed by a second, and a third...
They grew upwards rapidly, intertwining with each other, as though a great sculptor is creating life out of a rock with the chisel of time.
The white plant-like frame is completed in a few minutes, standing quietly in the pot, approximately thirty centimeters tall.
Its branches are stark and strong, but it is composed of a jade-like calcareous substance with a delicate, tree-ring-like texture on the surface.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Did she just create a 'tree' with her powers?)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (Are the other 'plants' her works too?)
It seems the office has suddenly fallen silent.
Of course, the office has not been particularly noisy since she came in at noon.
Now, though, it feels as if there is something in the air preventing her from speaking.
It is a familiar feeling.
She once shadowed Kristen, hoping to find out what the Control is doing when she is out of office.
She found out that Kristen had gone to the rooftop of the Rhine Lab HQ building, staring at the sky for two full hours.
Right now, Saria gives Helen the same feeling that Kristen once did.
Though they had what some might say were the greatest things on Terra, it is only in this moment that they truly belong to themselves.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Fascinating, isn't it?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: We were surprised when we learned about Saria's hobby of making these calcified plants.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: ...Director Franks? When did you—

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Shh, don't disturb Saria.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Oh, okay. Why did you...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You used to be Kristen's secretary, right?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I came to calibrate the equipment for her before I leave. You should learn to do it; it could come in handy.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The fitness corner and shower were designed by Nasti, at Saria's request.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Saria hasn't been back to this office in a while. Fortunately, all the data collection was done on Rhodes Island, which saves some effort.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Wait, did you say... leave?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Oh, it's not what you think.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm going on a business trip to the frontiers for a while, so I wanted to get certain things out of the way before I go.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: What's on your mind?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: ...I know Kristen wasn't as indifferent as people outside thought she was.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Saria's work attitude is the polar opposite of Kristen's, but I feel like I see the same thing in both of them...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Their work, or should I say Rhine Lab, is not actually that important to them.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: ...Very astute.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: What exactly is Rhine Lab to them?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: ...I'm sorry, I shouldn't have asked.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: There was a meeting of section directors in the aftermath of the Galleria Stellaria incident. At the meeting, Saria said—

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: 'Kristen is not the embodiment of greatness. She is a flawed human being, just like the rest of us.'

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: 'But she opened a door, and the light of greatness shines from beyond the door.'

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Why shouldn't 'greatness' be the ideal?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Because an ideal is a dream that can save everyone, while 'greatness' is not. It is cold and hard, often oppressive.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But it's the fate of a scientist to be drawn by such a light, and Saria is no exception.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: What were you drawn to, Helen?
Helen looks up.
The sun shines through the window on Saria, who is fully focused on her plant, as though there is nothing that can disturb her.
The scene is a strange one, yet somehow holy at the same time.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: I hate to admit it... but I guess it's not the light that I was drawn to, but the people who were drawn to the light.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Is that not enough?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: I suppose it is.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Saria, I've calibrated your equipment based on the Rhodes Island figures.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The paperwork is in order. Just consider it an extended business trip. Anything you need, Rhine can provide.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No problem. The Site 359 matter is settled, and I've resumed work in the Originium Art Section.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You know it doesn't really matter to me where I do my experiments.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Oh, and Muelsyse stopped me in the corridors with tears on her face. She complained that she's been doing too many goodbyes lately, and insisted on seeing me off personally.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: She's been touchy lately.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: A bit of sentimentality isn't a bad thing in times like these.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That's not something I would expect you to say.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Don't you know? I've always been a sentimental girl.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's true that I don't know you that well.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Of all the directors, we've worked with each other the least.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That will change.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: How are you planning to change Rhine Lab, Saria?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm not the one changing it. It will change of its own, in whatever way it chooses. My job is just to keep it going.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You know, maybe I was wrong about you.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I thought you saw freedom as Kristen's special privilege. But the truth is, you allow everyone other than yourself to have freedom, don't you?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm not that great.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Neither was Kristen.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Bye, Saria. This time, you'll have all my experiment data.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Good. See you.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Oh, and I think your secretary has some questions. Don't forget about her.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Uh, pay no mind to what Director Franks said, I don't actually have anything to ask...

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: I don't suppose you even know my name...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Helen. I remember.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Mm—huh?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You were with Kristen when she came to find me a few years ago.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Jara told me about you too. She believes you're up to the job of supporting me.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: But I haven't been able to help at all...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I could deal with today's things on my own. But I've been away from Rhine Lab for a while, and there are many things about Rhine that I don't know as well as you do. I'll be counting on you.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: (...I'm sorry, Saria, but from what I saw today, I can't imagine the day that you'll be counting on me!)

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: It'll be an honor to work for you!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: What was it that you wanted to ask?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Well... I had a question, but it's not important now.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: I was going to ask why you want to keep using this office, instead of moving into the Control's office.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You found the answer?

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: I thought maybe you were honoring Kristen.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Or maybe you wanted to make it clear to others that you're going to do things differently from Kristen.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: But now, I suspect it's not so complicated after all.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I didn't want to move my office because everything in this office was tailor made for me.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm not used to Kristen's office, and I'm not as comfortable there. It's that simple.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Yeah... I don't suppose there's another office in Rhine Lab with a boxing ring and shower.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Break's over. Let's get to work.

steps.name: Helen the Secretary
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.
